description: A horizontal row of large-number metrics with labels. Use for quantified credentials or social proof (e.g. '+30 years experience', '100+ clients').

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Optional section heading above the stats row. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

background_image.description: Optional background image URL. When set, renders as a CSS background-image with a dark overlay for text readability.

items.description: Array of stat items. Each: { number: string, label: string }.

number.description: The metric value, e.g. '+30' or '100+'. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

label.description: The metric label, e.g. 'Years of experience'. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

--stats-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--stats-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--stats-title-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading, if set

--stats-number-color.description: Stat number (large metric value) text color

--stats-number-size.description: Stat number (large metric value) font size

--stats-radius.description: Border radius of the stats band. Pair with --stats-max-width for a contained, rounded metrics card.

--stats-max-width.description: Maximum width of the stats band. When set, the band is capped to this width and centered (auto side margins), producing a contained card; the default 'none' spans full width unchanged.
